_README: Which run directories each StuLife arm is built from.
Both `scripts/build_stulife_table.py` and `scripts/plot_stulife_curves.py` read this file, so
the two artifacts are always built from the same runs.
TO REPRODUCE WITH YOUR OWN RUNS: copy this file, replace each glob with your run directories,
and pass --runs-manifest yours.json to either script. Globs are resolved against --runs-root
(default: the repo root), and may name any directory under it. They must be RELATIVE:
Path.glob refuses an absolute pattern, so put the prefix in --runs-root instead. Pass --out
(table) / --out-dir (curves) as well, or the artifacts built from your runs overwrite the
UNLIKE THE APPWORLD MANIFEST, an arm here is usually ONE run directory holding several
attempts, not several run directories of one attempt each: the StuLife arms were launched with
`--attempts 3`. Both shapes work -- every attempt of every matched run becomes a rep -- but it
is why these globs name a single directory where the AppWorld ones end in `-rep-*`.
WHY THE LETTA ARM'S RUN PREDATES ITS SIBLINGS (08-26 vs the others' 08-29/08-30/09-05): it is
the latest COMPLETE run of that arm. Not a stale pointer; it is the one to use. The four later
Letta runs and why each was rejected, so the choice can be re-checked rather than trusted:
20260901T073919Z and 20260901T074325Z have partially-written attempts, 20260903T014427Z is the
minimal-search-guidance ablation rather than the baseline, and 20260903T130138Z is .superseded.
